Claire (AE): ACME POC asked for 7yr audit log retention + HSM-backed keys. Single SKU or separate billables? Need line items for partner quote.

Marco (Solutions): Separate. Base logging (30d) included on enterprise. >90d needs audit-retention add-on billed per GB-month. HSM/KMS (BYOK) is separate: one-time setup + monthly mgmt.

Priya (CS): HIPAA package is separate (DPA + monitoring). Audit retention and HSM still billed separately.

Claire (AE): Can you give rough numbers to include in quote?

Marco (Solutions): Ballpark: audit-retention hot: $0.02/GB-mo (30d-1y); cold/archival >1y: $0.005/GB-mo (7yr use); HSM/KMS: $10,000 one-time + $500/mo mgmt; HIPAA package: $2,000/mo. SOC2 included unless extended retention.

Priya (CS): Note egress/export fees for archival exports (standard S3 rates).

Ethan (SalesOps): Discount guidance: ~10-15% off recurring add-ons at ~$100k+ ARR commits; >20% needs Deal Desk + RevOps.

Claire (AE): Customer proposing 12mo commit ~150k ARR. Ask to waive $10k HSM setup or amortize over term.

Ethan (SalesOps): For $150k ARR we can capitalize setup over term and consider up to 50% waiver with exec OK. Full waiver needs senior approval. I'll open Deal Desk if you log ARR/term/margin.

Marco (Solutions): Ops note: HSM-backed keys for HIPAA data residency require "customer-managed keys" in Private config and 2-3 day security review.

Claire (AE): Example quote lines to include: ```- Audit retention (7yr cold): 12,000GB x $0.005 = $600/mo - HSM Setup: $10,000 (or capitalized $833/mo) - HSM Mgmt: $500/mo - HIPAA package: $2,000/mo```

Marco (Solutions): Add caveat: cold-tier assumes immutable storage; restores >30d may incur retrieval fees.

Priya (CS): Also include clause: retention >1y needs approved policy and may require legal review for country-specific mandates.

Claire (AE): @Ethan please start Deal Desk with these numbers and request 50% HSM setup waiver. I'll attach POC sizing.

Ethan (SalesOps): Creating Deal Desk ticket, looping RevOps + Legal. @LegalBot flag DPA/export constraints for EU/UK.

LegalBot: Noted. EU 7yr retention requires lawful basis + DPA amendments. If they need HSM attestations, we can provide vendor certs.

Claire (AE): Thanks. I'll send partner quote with two options (capitalized setup vs upfront). Will update after Deal Desk. :pray:
